title: Penix returns, but protection is the next question for Falcons–Packers

title: Rays–Yankees nightcap: the lineup question behind 6.5

title: Peyton Watson’s Cavaliers fit is not an automatic under

title: Hurricanes–Panthers: Read the roster before the rematch

title: Chargers–Bills: the tight-end reset is bigger than Gadsden's targets

title: Brewers–Phillies: separate Wheeler’s rebound from the total
excerpt: Zack Wheeler’s recent form supports run prevention. Dustin May’s uneven workload complicates the full-game total—and our model evidence cannot resolve the disagreement.
